Process flagged rows in the analysis data creating additional categories

Source: R/mod_summary_table.R
process_flagged_rows.Rd

Process flagged rows in the analysis data creating additional categories

Usage

process_flagged_rows(
  filtered_df,
  pop_df,
  unfiltered_df,
  flagged_row_processing,
  group_vars,
  row_vars,
  subjid_var
)

Arguments

filtered_df

[data.frame] A data frame containing the filtered analysis data.

pop_df

[data.frame] A data frame containing the filtered population data.

unfiltered_df

[data.frame | NULL] A data frame containing the unfiltered analysis data.

flagged_row_processing

[list(1+) | NULL] A list of lists defining the processing and categorization of flagged rows.

group_vars

[character(1+)] A vector of names of population grouping variables.

row_vars

[character(0+)] A vector of names of row categorization variables.

subjid_var

[character(1)] A string representing the subject identifier column.

Value

Analysis data frame with additional rows added corresponding to flagged rows. Flagged row variable names are added to the attribute named flagged_row_vars.
